opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK Office (September deadline)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; applications are not accepted from individuals without organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed‑funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together in arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, or sport. Supports festivals, exchanges, collaborative outputs, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and early‑career health‑related professionals are also welcome. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and focus on medicine and health.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic healthcare issues. Grants can fund travel, conference, and publication costs but not consumables, salaries or capital projects.
